description: A bash script to generate FIT image source files compatible with Qualcomm SDK sysupgrade format. It creates a device tree source (DTS) file defining images and their properties based on input arguments, facilitating firmware flashing and upgrades.
external_files: the image files specified as input arguments in the script
external_methods: used to get the script's basename in usage message

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays usage information and exits if incorrect arguments are supplied.

search-terms: shell script for firmware image creation
